source.method: observed crosswalk (44 dims) + DeepSeek LLM inference layer (Layer-2, 422 inferable dims, evidence-grounded verbatim quotes)

notes: Stratified 200-person rich subset of CGSS2017 (age x gender balanced, seed 42). Full 1290-dim records: 44 dims observed via crosswalk + ~60-110 dims LLM-inferred (Personality, Values & Motivation, Behavior, Linguistic, Health, Life Events, topic_* interests) with verbatim evidence quotes from the rendered Chinese profile_text. validate_extraction.py: 0 errors; avg 105.4 grounded dims/persona (vs 29.3 observed-only); 12,809 summary_inference + 6,303 direct values. LLM: DeepSeek via application/playground/.env.local (MATRIX_PERSONA_MODEL config). Isolation: cgss2017- prefixed user_ids, China-only cohort. 19 rows hit API 402 mid-run were redone (redo_llm_batch.py).
